paper.title: R-Zero: Self-Evolving Reasoning LLM from Zero Data
paper.central_claim: R-Zero co-evolves a Challenger and a Solver from one base LLM with GRPO and self-consistency pseudo-labels, with no external tasks/labels, improving math (+6.49 on Qwen3-4B-Base) and general reasoning.

provenance.notes: Opus aggregate seat via the configured claude-kimi type fable; no route probing. actual_model/session_id/receipt_ref are null because the subagent runtime exposes no verifiable provider receipt to this worker.

sections_read: Opus: complete pinned text read end-to-end (abstract, all sections, tables, appendices) before opening seat records; targeted re-reads for every disputed field

evidence.quote: In the Solver training phase, the Solver is fine-tuned with GRPO on a filtered set of these challenging questions generated by the now-frozen Challenger, using the pseudo-labels voted by itself.
evidence.support_explanation: 问题集是交替模型训练的数据接口，不是memory/skill/workflow编辑产物。

evidence.quote: This function incentivizes questions where the Solver is maximally uncertain (accuracy approaches 50%).
evidence.support_explanation: 不确定性驱动Challenger生成前沿问题；一致性不是独立真值。

evidence.quote: This filtering step discards tasks that are either too easy or too hard.
evidence.support_explanation: 固定难度过滤规则作用于训练样本，不说明规则本身进化。

evidence.quote: After multiple iterations, we observe a consistent and concerning trend of performance degradation across all models.
evidence.support_explanation: 作者直接报告多轮退化，不能泛称持续无界自我改进。

evidence.quote: while the accuracy of the pseudo-labels is initially high at 79.0%, it systematically drops to 63.0% by the third iteration.
evidence.support_explanation: 本文自身200题/轮GPT-4o审计报告的伪标签误差；不是卡片成员结果。

evidence.quote: In this configuration (Single-R-Zero), a single model is tasked with performing both roles, i.e., generating a challenging curriculum and subsequently learning from it.
evidence.support_explanation: 统一模型消融改变角色参数共享，不改变被评价对象仍为权重。

evidence.quote: This section presents the exact prompt templates used for the solver and challenger models.
evidence.support_explanation: 固定模板公开；Appendix H的去数学prompt是人工设置消融，不是自动留存prompt改进。

evidence.quote: For this analysis, we assumed the external oracle model, GPT-4o, to be a perfect annotator, providing the ground truth answers for all generated questions.
evidence.support_explanation: 伪标签诊断用外部模型而非执行真值，诊断有校准边界；不等于训练使用外部标签。

evidence.quote: In the Challenger training phase, the Challenger is trained via GRPO to generate difficult questions.
In the Solver training phase, the Solver is fine-tuned with GRPO on a filtered set of these challenging questions generated by the now-frozen Challenger, using the pseudo-labels voted by itself.
evidence.support_explanation: Solver is weight-fine-tuned; generated data is only a training set.

evidence.quote: The entire framework is self-supervised, requiring no human intervention.
evidence.support_explanation: No non-weight retained harness component (prompt/skill/tool/memory/workflow) is part of the loop.

evidence.quote: the Challenger is trained via Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO)
In the Solver training phase, the Solver is fine-tuned with GRPO on a filtered set of these challenging questions generated by the now-frozen Challenger, using the pseudo-labels voted by itself.
evidence.support_explanation: Solver update target is weights; generated questions are training data.

evidence.quote: All results are reported based on the held-out test sets
evidence.support_explanation: Evaluated product = Solver checkpoints on public benchmarks (informational).

claims.text: Competitive deep RL performance with52–98% lower training time and fewer interactions.
claims.setting: Pong/Breakout/SpaceInvaders, OCAtari object state, frame skip4,sticky_action0;20 configured optimization iterations; Sonnet20241022 backend.
claims.baseline_control: CleanRL/public DQN and PPO logs;8parallel baseline vs1agent; human reference.
claims.selection_vs_test: Best code/score within optimization; same full-game reward informs optimizer; no held-back final evaluation protocol.
claims.result_denominator: Table2: agent21/353/1200 at43m/91m/36m; DQN20/302/1383 at606m/1614m/1612m; PPO19/443/939 at144m/188m/339m. PPO beats agent Breakout; DQN and human beat SpaceInvaders. No episode averaging count or CI. Table3 action summary omits combined FIRE+MOVE while AppendixF combine_actions returns4/5, an interface documentation ambiguity.
counterevidence: Different observations/human priors/hardware and stop rules prevent strict efficiency attribution. Efficient32-env Breakout~450in33m disclosed. No full short+long rollout interaction count, token/dollar cost.
claims.allowed_conclusion: Author-reported useful scores and selected-baseline wall-clock savings on three configured games; no general or equal-information/equal-budget RL superiority.

claims.text: Full-game staged feedback overcomes long-horizon sparse-reward plateau.
claims.setting: Pong short rollout400 vs long evaluation~4000; staged thresholds19/0; Breakout/Invaders separate hand-written reward bins.
claims.baseline_control: Pong rollout-only vs rollout+full-game staged feedback
claims.selection_vs_test: Feedback and score drawn from same optimization process; best/max results.
claims.result_denominator: Table5 max7 vs21; no runs/seeds/uncertainty or2×2 staging/horizon decomposition.
counterevidence: Additional long evaluation consumes extra interactions; it and semantic staging co-vary. No graph-off/one-shot/random local edit code baseline.
claims.allowed_conclusion: Bundled long-game staged feedback helps this Pong setup; neither staging alone nor graph credit isolated.

claims.text: LLM infers game physics and yields interpretable/verifiable adaptable policies.
claims.setting: One omitted wall constant example plus initial/learned program appendix.
claims.baseline_control: Human partially specified docstring/scaffold; no physics-task baseline or formal verification.
claims.selection_vs_test: Selected illustrative bounce and learned source; no unseen physical conditions.
claims.result_denominator: AppendixD bounce x152→146,dx+6→−6; LOC Pong49→131,Breakout95→125,Invaders117→146; cyclomatic complexity grows to16/24/28.
counterevidence: Extensive game-specific docstrings/strategies already supplied; code growth does not certify interpretability/safety; no perturbation/transfer test or formal invariant proof.
claims.allowed_conclusion: Readable code and an illustrative inferred boundary; broad causal-reasoning/generalization/formal-verification claim untested.
